hooks.text: 每局收集的复古游戏不会重置，封装、盒装、签名与进口版本会永久累积成收藏档案。
hooks.excerpt: And best of all? Retros never reset. No matter how your run ends, your retro collection stays with you, growing stronger with every playthrough.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 要维持收银、补货和顾客耐心，并随业务增长扩店、增设货架和重排布局。
hooks.excerpt: Help your customers on the checkout counter, make sure your shop is well stocked and that you serve them on time, otherwise they'll lose patience and leave.. As your business grows, so does your store! Expand to fit more shelves, attract more customers, and reorganize your layout to maximize efficiency.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 每天早晨卡车会带来品类加成、折扣、店铺评级和掉落倍率等报价，需要按当天需求购买。
hooks.excerpt: Every morning, The Truck arrives with offers: bonuses for some genres, discounts for others, store rating accelerations, loot amplification, and many others. Anticipate your needs wisely and purchase them strategically.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

baseline.message: 首期基线，暂无可比趋势。
